'''''Hutt Greed''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The painting depicted an artist's sketch of a [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]], a ship commonly used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] employed by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal organizations.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Hutt Greed'' was a painting that appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The image used for the painting came from the art book ''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]'' which was included with the collector's edition of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' and is one of the pieces of concept art for the player-owned ships included in the game's first expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''.<ref name="Pencil">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref> The painting itself was one of nine paintings given out randomly to players of the game for the game's first anniversary of release in the United States and Europe. The player could use the painting in their house as decoration.<ref name="SWG" />
